scope: Read-only integrity verification of the original blinded 202-item template, frozen criteria/protocol, 14 packets, all 32 current-manifest source files, 150 distinct source excerpts and 105 work cases. The source scope includes the original 28 files plus four actual implementation contexts authorized by root before freeze. No answer quality or experimental results computed.

details.scope_update: Root authorized the current manifest containing four additional implementation-context source files before freeze.

excerpt_hash_convention: sha256('\n'.join(source_text.splitlines()[start_line-1:end_line]).encode('utf-8')); do not strip terminal blank lines or add a terminal line separator.
question_key_convention: First 12 hex characters of SHA256 of canonical JSON encoding of the question string, using the same canonical JSON settings.

saved_binding_validation.verification_limit: This audit checks saved binding-validation report consistency only. It does not read or independently rehash any raw file.

normalization_correction: The earlier group-a warnings for vectorstores/base.py 908–964 and 963–1022 arose from stripping terminal blank lines. Both pass this audit under the required exact join convention. Original assessment is preserved for root adjudication.
audit_revision_note: Initial audit calculation used a hardcoded expected source-file count of 28 after the manifest had expanded to 32. All 32 source hashes already passed; this revision adopts the root-authorized current manifest count and adds comparisons against its three work-file hashes. No source-hash failure was found.
